LanguageData.CC_SetSec_Automations: Automations: the council does it for you
LanguageData.CC_SetSec_Automations_Note: Everything here is off unless you switch it on. Switched on, the council does each hour what it would otherwise only suggest, tells you in a quiet message, and keeps a log on the check-myself page. Your own orders are never touched: a bill you remove isn't set again for a fortnight, and whatever the council does is undone the ordinary way, on the bench, in the plan, or on the map. Nothing happens while there is fighting on the map.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBills: Bills for what the colony lacks
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBills_Tip: From the Making page's findings: a "make until" bill for a staple the colony lacks and can make (meals, medicine, components), and for whatever the blueprints and the other bills are waiting on (blocks for a wall, cloth for a tailor's bill), two an hour at most. A bill you remove isn't set again for a fortnight.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoBills: Benches get their bills for the staples and for what the building needs.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBillMeals_Tip: A bill for meals when the colony lacks them and a stove can make them: three days' worth, two a head a day.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBillMedicine_Tip: A bill for medicine when the colony lacks it and a bench can make it: two a head.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoBillMedicine: The drug lab keeps medicine in.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBillComponents_Tip: A bill for components when the colony lacks them and a fabrication bench can make them: eight.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoBillComponents: The fabrication bench keeps a few components made.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBillChains: ... and the chains, link by link
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBillChains_Tip: Whatever the blueprints and the other bills wait on, followed to the end on the Making page: a bill on each bench down the chain, the parts' first, each to make until the next link has what it takes and three days of its use.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoBillChains: What the building and the bills wait on gets made, down to the parts.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoPlan: Urgent steps go straight into the plan
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoPlan_Tip: A step the council proposes at a high level or above is taken into the plan at once, in its place by urgency, instead of waiting for you on the Plan page. Let it go there like any other if you disagree.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoPlan: The plan fills itself with what presses.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoResearch: An idle research bench takes up the next project
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoResearch_Tip: With a research bench and no project chosen, the cheapest project of the colony's own era is started (never one that pushes the colony into the next era). Pick another in the research tab whenever you like; the council waits a day before choosing again.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoStockpile: Goods nobody stores get a stockpile
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoStockpile_Tip: When the stores review finds a fair amount of goods lying about that no store accepts, the stockpile it would lay out by the store room is made, set to take exactly those goods, every five days at most. An ordinary zone afterwards.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoStockpile: Odds and ends find a home.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoTakeDown: What serves nothing is taken down
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoTakeDown_Tip: The base review's take-down findings get their deconstruct orders: wall stubs that separate nothing, dead conduit and pipe ends, doors with the same room on both sides. Cancel an order on the map like any other; a finding is acted on every two days at most.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoTakeDown: Stubs, dead ends and pointless doors go.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoLamps: Dark bedrooms and benches get lamps and chairs planned
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoLamps_Tip: What the advisor's "plan the lamps" and "plan chairs and lamps" buttons do, done once a day when the advice stands: blueprints for a lamp in a bedroom too dark to see by, a chair at a bench with none. Cancel a blueprint like any other.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoLamps: Lamps and chairs are planned where they are missing.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoFirewood: Trees are marked for chopping when firewood runs short
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoFirewood_Tip: When the advisor says the woodpile won't see the cold through, the nearest mature trees outside your growing zones are marked for chopping, five to twelve by how short the wood is, once a day at most. Unmark any on the map.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoFirewood: The woodpile is seen to before the cold.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoGrow: A thing a plant yields gets sown for
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoGrow_Tip: A link of a chain on the Making page that no bench makes but a plant the colony can sow yields (cotton for cloth, healroot for herbal medicine), with no zone growing it yet: that many cells are sown for it, beside the fields on fertile, open ground, once every ten days per thing. An ordinary zone afterwards.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoGrow: The fields grow what the chains want.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBudget: Materials budget a day for what the automations plan
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoBudget_Tip: The blueprints the automations place in a day (lamps, chairs) are worth at most this much, as the things are worth built. Once it is spent, nothing more is planned until the next day.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoBudget: Blueprints worth up to this much a day.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoTakeDownsADay: Take-down orders a day at most
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoTakeDownsADay_Tip: How many stubs, dead ends and doors the council may order down in one day across the base.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoTakeDownsADay: So many things ordered down a day.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoChopsADay: Trees marked for chopping a day at most
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AutoChopsADay_Tip: How many trees the council may mark in one day when firewood is short.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_AutoChopsADay: So many trees marked a day.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_BillSet: The council set a bill on the {BENCH}: {PRODUCT}, until {N} ({WHY}).
LanguageData.CC_Auto_Grow: The council sowed {N} cell(s) of {PLANT}, for {PRODUCT}.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_BudgetSpent: {WHAT}: waits, the day's materials budget is spent.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_SectionTip: Each switch is under Building in the settings. For each, what the council would do now (or does, switched on), and the last things it did, each undone at a click.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_UndoTip: Takes it back: the bill off the bench (and not set again for a fortnight), the step back to proposed, the research pick, the zone, the orders, the blueprints, the marks.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_Planned: The council put a step into the plan: {STEP}.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_Research: The research bench stood idle: the council started {PROJECT}.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_Stockpile: The council made a stockpile for the goods nobody stored ({WHAT}).
LanguageData.CC_Auto_Acted: The council planned what the advisor asked for: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_Auto_Firewood: Firewood is short before the cold: the council marked {N} tree(s) near the base for chopping.
LanguageData.CC_Check_Auto_None: Every automation is off: the council only suggests. Switch them on under Building in the settings.
